description: This is a class definition for EmployeeMembershipDecorator, which acts as a decorator for the EmployeeMembership entity. It provides methods to set related entities and retrieve formatted subscription dates and currency names, integrating various services and traits.

classes.name: EmployeeMembershipDecorator
classes.description: Decorator class for EmployeeMembership entity, providing helper methods to modify and retrieve related data with service integrations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with an EmployeeMembership instance.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee related to this membership by employee number.

methods.name: setMembershipByMembershipId
methods.description: Sets the Membership related to this employee membership by membership ID.

methods.name: getSubscriptionCommenceDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted subscription commence date.

methods.name: getSubscriptionRenewalDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted subscription renewal date.

methods.name: getCurrencyName
methods.description: Returns the name of the subscription currency by fetching currency info via a service.
